components.content:
## Unit Conversion Reference

### Dynamic (Absolute) Viscosity
- 1 cP = 0.001 Pa·s = 0.01 P
- 1 Pa·s = 1 kg/(m·s) = 1000 cP
- 1 lb/(ft·s) = 1.48816 Pa·s = 1488.16 cP
- 1 lb/(ft·h) = 0.00041338 Pa·s = 0.41338 cP

### Kinematic Viscosity
- 1 cSt = 1 mm²/s = 1×10⁻⁶ m²/s
- 1 m²/s = 1×10⁶ cSt
- 1 ft²/s = 92903.04 cSt
- 1 St = 100 cSt

For full unit conversion details, see the [Dynamic Viscosity Converter](dynamic-viscosity-d_571.html) and [Kinematic Viscosity Converter](kinematic-viscosity-d_570.html).
